decisions.reason: The candidate already has a message-6 MODIFY that narrows source_content to the provided YouTube channel. The topic and moment-selection details belong to separate content-selection standards, so no additional candidate-state change is required.
Message 6 directly introduced the effective-hook requirement, which is already represented in the candidate history. The source-material and topic changes do not alter the existing hook-quality rule.
The clean-edit standard was independently introduced by message 6 and remains valid unchanged; narrowing the source material and removing a topic constraint do not modify editing_style.
